planets.name: LTT 3780 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of LTT 3780 with a 0.768-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: LTT 3780 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around LTT 3780. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
